description: Build a valid SPF TXT record for a domain from the email services it sends with. Returns the DNS host and the TXT value to publish, plus warnings such as nearing the 10-lookup limit. It does not change DNS.

a.description: true if the server at the domain's A record sends mail (adds the a mechanism).

includes.description: Other include: domains, e.g. sendgrid.net, mailgun.org.

ip4.description: IPv4 addresses or ranges that send for the domain, e.g. 203.0.113.7 or 203.0.113.0/24.

ip6.description: IPv6 addresses or CIDR ranges of your own mail servers, e.g. 2001:db8::1 or 2001:db8::/32. Find them in your server or hosting settings. Leave out if you only send through a provider.

mx.description: true if the domain's own mail servers send mail (adds the mx mechanism).

providers.description: The mailbox providers the domain sends from; each adds that provider's include. google = Google Workspace, microsoft = Microsoft 365, zoho = Zoho Mail, zoho-eu = Zoho Mail (EU data center).

strict.description: true = -all (hard fail), false = ~all (soft fail, the safer default).

name: generate_spf_record

host.description: Where to publish it: the DNS name (host) of the TXT record.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a free web tool on pipefire.ai.

value.description: The record value to paste into DNS.

warnings.description: Things to check before publishing, such as nearing the SPF 10-lookup limit. Empty when there are none.

title: SPF record generator
